decision.proposal: Choose separate schema-version-1 Fabric, Flow, ContextStore and optional Platform databases under one manifest-controlled root. This is an explicit choice among the layouts permitted by the plan. Validate root/store manifests before SQLite opening; require schema/profile/instance consistency and reject incomplete or unsupported initialization without modifying it. Commit authoritative records, projections, request mappings and the source-owned outbox atomically within each owning database, with expected revisions and uniqueness constraints. Preserve append-only history and deterministic replay. Publish durable artifact bytes before advertising references. Use exclusive offline backup/restore covering manifests, database and required WAL state, and referenced artifacts; validate the complete restore before publication. AQ-coordinated backup and runtime recovery remain integration work. Implementation and fault-injection/backup tests remain required.
